they said just take this it won't even do anything to you
just make you laugh, so I grabbed it and lite it up.
I took one hoot then they said more!! So I took another one and held it in for 10 seconds then I breathed it out and instantly my vision was haywired, I was like 'Holy fuck' then there like 'are you feeling it?' then I felt my mind splitting from reality which was by far the scariest thing I have ever felt then I curled up in to a little ball and started screaming my lungs out, and everyones like holy shit is he ok? Then I went absolutly beserk! I don't remember doing this obviously, they just said this is what happened! They said I started moaning and cursing and screaming then they said I was trying to rip out my jaw:S all I remember is being stuck in another realm that felt like an eternity and I was hearing laughing and I felt entrapment!
And as soon as I started coming out of this trip I saw everyone standing out side the truck scared of me:( and then I felt like that was only a dream this can't have possibly have happened, this cannot be real. Then I felt STRONG feelings of suicide because I was so scared!!! I never thought that would ever happen to me or that could ever happen cause it felt so FUCKED!! Like holy SHIT!!!!!!! I can't even explain how I felt I was just completley gone from reality! I was lost!!!
